analysis.headline: Shares Your Info Extensively
analysis.quote: We share information we collect, infrastructure, systems and technology with the other Meta Companies. Meta Products share information with other Meta Companies: To promote safety, security and integrity and comply with applicable laws To personalize offers, ads and other sponsored or commercial content To develop, provide and personalize features and integrations To understand how people use and interact with Meta Company Products

analysis.headline: Shares with Ad Partners
analysis.quote: Here’s more detail about who we share information with: Partners Advertisers and Audience Network publishers Partners who use our analytics services Partners who offer goods or services on our Products and commerce services platforms Integrated partners Vendors Measurement vendors Marketing vendors Service providers Service providers Third parties External researchers AI integrations Other third parties

analysis.headline: Collects Your Off-Platform Data
analysis.quote: We’ll use information that advertisers, businesses and other partners provide us about activity off Meta Company Products that we have associated with you to personalize ads that we show you on our Products, and on websites, apps and devices that use our advertising services.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Sensitive Info
analysis.quote: Any information with special protections that you choose to provide, such as your religious views, your sexual orientation, political views, health, racial or ethnic origin, philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, or as part of surveys you choose to participate in, and where you have given your explicit consent

analysis.headline: Uses Your Content for AI
analysis.quote: Interactions with AI at Meta and related metadata. For example, information you or others exchange with AI at Meta like content and messages.

analysis.headline: Your Content Reviewed Manually
analysis.quote: But in some cases, we also use manual review to access and review your information.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: We keep information as long as we need it to provide our Products, comply with legal obligations or protect our or other’s interests. We decide how long we need information on a case-by-case basis.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: We share information we collect globally, both internally across our offices and data centers and externally with our partners, third parties and service providers.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Government
analysis.quote: We access, preserve, use and share your information: In response to legal requests, like search warrants, court orders, production orders or subpoenas. These requests come from third parties such as civil litigants, law enforcement and other government authorities.
